questions.question: Six members of a family X, Y Z, U, V and W are sitting around a circular table facing each other. Z is sitting to the immediate left of W, and Y is sitting second to the left of Z. X is sitting second to the left of U. Who is the nearest neighbour of both W and X?
questions.solution:
**Given:** Six members of a family X, Y Z, U, V and W are sitting at a circular table facing each other.

1) Z sits immediate left of W, and Y sits second to the left of Z.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/46b25fa5d8046bb030bd75fad4fca6072093b19fcefaf392b3044f15c278ae38.png] 

2) X sits second to the left of U.

After positioning X and U only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2a9fa6b53fde44ad7232eba11bc1a353d325873d77e561cb463210a3c7f067d.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement V is the immediate neighbour of both W and X.

Hence,** "Option 4"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
In the following question some statements are given and some conclusions based on those statements. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions carefully and then decide which of the given conclusions logically follows from the given statements.

**Statements :**

I. No A is B.

II. Some B are P.

**Conclusions :**

I. Some B are not A.

II. Some P are not A.

options.text: None of the conclusions follow from the statements
Only conclusion I follows from the statements.
Only conclusion II follows from the statements.
Conclusion I and II follow from both the statements

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd64853a0a62d88cd76fd47c913ee80c85e3d5ffba77c117ce9d98814e21f772.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some B is not A → **F**ollow (As no A is B. As no A cannot be B, therefore it is true.)

II. Some P is not A → follow (As no A is B and some B is P. As P which are B, are not A. So, some B are not A is true.)

∴ Here, Conclusion I and II follow from both the statements.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4"

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

Detective : Clues :: Scientist : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic:** Association of profession with their primary activity or tool**.

Here,

Detective : Clues → **Detective** uses **Clues** to solve cases.

Similarly,

Scientist : Experiments → **Scientist** conducts **Experiments** to make discoveries or verify theories.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
